item.description: One of the main arteries between West Clare and Ennis will be closed next week to allow works to take place. item.title: Ennis Paint Scheme Deadline Extended
item.description: The deadline for the Ennis Paint Scheme has been extended. Business owners in the town now have an additional two weeks to apply for grants of up to €1,000 to re-design their shopfronts. A total fund of €424,000 is available under the scheme. Clare County Council is accepting applications until March 13th. The post Ennis Paint Scheme Deadline Extended appeared first on Clare FM.

item.title: New Taxi Service Rolled Out In Clare
item.description: A new taxi service is now available in Clare. As part of a major national expansion, online Platform Bolt will be making over 150 licensed drivers available in this county. There are currently just 464 taxi drivers operating in Clare, which is the second fewest in the province.
